gallery.title: File:Side Theatre panorama.jpg
gallery.description: It was built in the 2nd century, so is of Roman design, but the architect used the Greek style of letting the auditorium stretch for 30 degrees more than the (Roman style) 180 degrees. The stage building must have been wonderfully adorned, but the decorations are now heavily damaged. This is partly due to a heavy earthquake. In the 5th or 6th century it was used as an open air church. This is a computer-generated pciture.
